about.title: Hi, we're the HULKs!
paragraphs: We are a team of students from the Hamburg University of Technology competing in the RoboCup Humanoid Soccer League, founded in 2013.
Our robots run a custom robotics framework written from scratch in Rust, and our development process and code is completely open.
Since 2026, we compete with the Booster K1 platform in the newly formed Humanoid Soccer League, following our transition from the NAO and the Standard Platform League.

Beyond the development of robotics code, we seek to make robotics, software engineering, and artificial intelligence more accessible to the public by hosting conferences, talks, and workshops. Since 2014 we run our own annual event — RoHOW.
